authorization: User explicitly requests actual npm publication after CI and Secret configuration.
required_changes: Advance both SDK version files together
Create and push a new immutable SDK preview tag at the exact tested clean revision
Run the existing full Windows/Web/GitHub Release/private npm pipeline
Verify the published registry version, preview tag and package integrity/source manifest
allowed_source_changes: narrow release-tooling fixes required by real CI failures, preserving all existing qualification gates
forbidden_changes: Force-push, retagging, existing asset overwrite or npm version overwrite
Literal secrets in source or evidence
Runtime behavior changes or main merge
Stable release or physical/Gate acceptance claims
hosted_verification_required: Windows SDK consumer build and regression
terminal_success: The exact package/version and preview dist-tag are visible in the private registry, package integrity/source match the published Release, and the exact tag/revision/run are returned
terminal_blockers: Registry authorization or CI network denied
Frozen build/qualification failure requiring product changes outside release scope
Unavailable locked dependency or runner environment
credential: Existing GitHub Secret AXIOM_NPM_TOKEN; never materialize its value
prior_constraint_supersession: The previous task's no-real-publication limitation is superseded by this explicit user request; its original record and evidence remain immutable.
